camel_example: aliyun ens RenewARMServerInstance --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId yourInstance_ID --Period 1 --PeriodUnit Month
description_en: Renews a subscription Android in Container (AIC) instance
description_zh: 调用RenewARMServerInstance续费一台包年包月AIC实例
kebab_example: aliyun ens renew-arm-server-instance --instance-id yourInstance_ID --period 1 --period-unit Month --region cn-hangzhou
name: RenewARMServerInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance that you want to renew
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The renewal period. By default, instances are renewed on a monthly basis. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, and 12
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the renewal period. Valid values:

Month (default)

Year
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长的时间单位。取值：
Month（默认）
Year
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the premium bandwidth plan. Valid values:

true.

false (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费。取值：

true：自动续费
false：不自动续费（默认）
parameters.name: auto_renew
